annotations.title: Check a booking in or out

description: Mark a guest as arrived (check in) or departed (check out). Checkfront adds a note under the acting account. VOID and cancelled bookings cannot be checked in or out. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/checkin or /checkout.

booking_id.description: The booking code identifying the booking, e.g. CFPP-290317.

name: checkfront_check_in_booking
title: Check a booking in or out
